---
title: "Interactive demos"
---

Every interactive demo in the course, in teaching order. Each one also appears in
its unit's exercise, together with questions to explore.

## Transforming an image with a 2×2 matrix

Drag the two columns of the matrix and watch the image follow. Unit: [Images as arrays & geometric transforms](images/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="demos/dist/demo.css">
<div data-demo="matrix2x2" data-mode="image" data-a="1 0 0 1"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/matrix2x2.js"></script>
```

## 3×3 kernels

Edit nine weights and see the filtered image live; click a pixel to see the weighted sum. Unit: [Filtering & convolution](kernels/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="kernel3x3" data-image="cell" data-preset="gauss"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/kernel3x3.js"></script>
```

## Build a wave from five frequencies

Unit: [Images in frequency space](fourier/exercise.qmd#explore-wave).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="fourierwave" data-a="1 0 0 0 0"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/fourierwave.js"></script>
```

## Filter an image in frequency space

Keep or remove parts of the 2D spectrum and see the image rebuilt. Unit: [Images in frequency space](fourier/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="fourier2d" data-mode="low" data-max="30"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/fourier2d.js"></script>
```

## The energy of a line profile

Segment a noisy 1D profile: thresholding against the labelling with the smallest energy, found exactly by dynamic programming. Unit: [Segmentation as energy minimisation](seg-energy/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="segchain" data-lambda="3"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/segchain.js"></script>
```

## Maximum flow, one augmenting path at a time

Step through Ford–Fulkerson on a small graph, see the residual graph, and the minimum cut at the end. Unit: [Graphs, cuts and maximum flow](maxflow/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="maxflow" data-preset="textbook"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/maxflow.js"></script>
```

## The graph of a small image

Pixels as nodes, t-links and n-links with their capacities, and the minimum cut; make your own cut and compare. Unit: [Graph-cut segmentation](graphcut-seg/exercise.qmd#explore-graph).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="pixelgraph" data-preset="row"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/pixelgraph.js"></script>
```

## Interactive graph cut

Paint object and background seeds and see the segmentation update. Unit: [Graph-cut segmentation](graphcut-seg/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="graphcut" data-preset="noise"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/graphcut.js"></script>
```

## Fiedler vectors and normalized cuts

Split points or a small image with the second eigenvector of the graph Laplacian. Unit: [Spectral partitioning and normalized cuts](ncut/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="ncut" data-preset="two"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/ncut.js"></script>
```

## Fit a line scan with a small neural network

Train a 1 → H → 1 ReLU network live and watch the hinges move. Unit: [Neural networks](neuralnet/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="nnfit" data-h="3"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/nnfit.js"></script>
```

## PCA as a linear autoencoder

Turn a one-number linear autoencoder on two-pixel images; train a nonlinear one on a curve. Unit: [From PCA to autoencoders](autoencoder/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="linae" data-data="pixels" data-angle="0"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/linae.js"></script>
```

## The VAE loss in one dimension

Move the encoder's cloud and see reconstruction, KL and their sum. Unit: [The variational autoencoder](vae/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="elbo1d"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/elbo1d.js"></script>
```

## Generating images with a VAE

Encode, decode, walk and sample in the 2D latent space of handwritten digits and of synthetic cell shapes. Unit: [Generating and exploring images](vae-gen/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="vaeimages" data-tabs="digits shapes"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/vaeimages.js"></script>
```

## Quantisation and dithering

Round an image to 1–8 bits, with or without dither, and see the error and its histogram. Unit: [Quantisation & bit depth](quantisation/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="quantise" data-image="ramp" data-bits="4"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/quantise.js"></script>
```

## How many bits does a camera need?

A simulated camera (full well, read noise, ADC bits, exposure) and its noise-versus-signal plot. Unit: [Quantisation & bit depth](quantisation/exercise.qmd#explore-camera).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="camerabits" data-fwc="30000" data-read="1.5" data-bits="16" data-exposure="0.5"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/camerabits.js"></script>
```

## Showing a 12-bit image: windows, wrap-around, CT windows

Unit: [12- and 16-bit images in practice](highbit/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="window16" data-image="fluo" data-preset="full"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/window16.js"></script>
```

## GPU texture formats

The same data in two texture formats side by side, stretched so the steps show; nearest or linear filtering (needs WebGL2). Unit: [How graphics cards store colour](gpuformats/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="texformats" data-a="RGBA8" data-b="RGB10_A2" data-image="dark"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/texformats.js"></script>
```

## The bits of a float

Unit: [Floating point](floatingpoint/exercise.qmd#explore).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="floatbits" data-format="float16" data-value="0.1"></div>
<script src="demos/dist/floatbits.js"></script>
```

Unit: [Floating point](floatingpoint/exercise.qmd#explore-sum).

```{=html}
<div data-demo="floatbits" data-view="sum" data-mean="1000" data-sd="50" data-n="22"></div>
```
